final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS standing, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS overall FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.standing, s1.avg_conf, s1.avg_conf - s2.overall AS diff FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.overall IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_conf > s2.overall), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS overall FROM s3) SELECT s3.standing, s3.avg_conf, s3.diff, s3.avg_conf / s4.overall FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.overall IS NOT NULL
